title: Variable Selection for Multivariate Failure Time Data via Regularized Sparse-Input Neural Network.
summary: The regularized sparse-input neural network is evaluated through simulations and applied to advanced prostate-cancer survival data, where the authors identify established clinical factors and candidate prognostic SNPs; those SNP associations are exploratory and not independently validated.
ai_technology: A regularized sparse-input neural network selects variables for multivariate failure-time analysis and is applied to prostate-cancer survival data.
